# Buzz (block/buzz)

`infra/compose.yml` contains service definitions adapted from `deploy/compose/compose.yml` in
https://github.com/block/buzz at tag `relay-v0.2.1` (commit 6e5c462ac524), licensed under the
Apache License 2.0 (copy in `LICENSE` next to this file).

Changes made here:

- Services renamed with a `buzz-` prefix (`postgres` -> `buzz-postgres`, `redis` -> `buzz-redis`,
  `minio` -> `buzz-s3`, `minio-init` -> `buzz-s3-init`) to share one compose project with Mattermost.
- Images pinned by exact tag and digest; the removed `minio/minio` and `minio/mc` images replaced by
  `pgsty/silo` and `pgsty/mc`, as Buzz main does.
- Secrets come from the repository `.env` (generated by `pnpm dev:up`) instead of `deploy/compose/.env`.
- Relay configured for local use: closed relay mode, owner key, relay URL and media URL on localhost,
  relay port bound to 127.0.0.1, no Caddy or TLS override.
